- So the last season without a back sponsor is the season just before 2009–2011, which is 2008– (the dash means ongoing, but in this case, the 2008– season ends when 2009–2011 starts).  

Checking the table:  
2008– row has no back sponsor.  
2009–2011 row has a back sponsor.
